1.consolidated_definition: Complicarse un asunto, resultar algo difícil de solucionar.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To complicate a matter, to make something difficult to resolve.

Alternatively:

To complicate an issue, to render it hard to solve.

Or:

To entangle a situation, to make it complicated and difficult to resolve.

Note: Las opciones anteriores son equivalentes y todas mantienen el significado exacto de la definición original.
